# Welcome, Microbial Superheroes {.unnumbered}

![](images/Microbial%20Superheroes%20course%20logo.png){fig-alt="Course logo showing a red, caped microscope surrounded by microbes" width=240}

This interactive workbook accompanies **LSC 170: Microbial Superheroes**. Each module uses
the **C.R.E.A.T.E.** method to read and understand primary scientific literature,
with the bacterium *Delftia tsuruhatensis* TC1 as our running example. Section 1 follows TC1 and malaria in mosquitoes; Section 2 follows TC1 and *Leishmania* in sand flies.

Learn more about [the author](about.qmd).

::: {.callout-tip}
## How to use this book
Work through each module in order. Answer the self-check questions, expand the
hint boxes, and type your notes into the text boxes — they are saved in your browser.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
Adapted from *The Delftia Book* [@sharma2026]. See the original for authoritative text and readings. Methods used across both sections are explained in [Appendix A](appendix-methods.qmd) and all sources are listed in [References](references.qmd).
:::
